title: DynamoDB Streams coverage
intro: Every DynamoDB Streams operation the emulator advertises, and what Emuplane does
with it. The service reads the records the main DynamoDB service emits on every write
that changes an item; it signs with the `dynamodb` credential scope and is told apart
by the `DynamoDBStreams_20120810` target prefix. There is no console action.
A table gets one synthetic shard and no shard splitting. Iterator tokens are opaque
and expire after 15 minutes, and a disabled stream stays readable for 24 hours.
